title: Hangame asr hai
body:
hangame asr hai ye sheh khoon ugal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
kul ambiya sirhane haaton ko mal rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa koi sitara sur khaasima hai saara
wo aandhiyan hai seeno mein dil behal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
yani na hai wo zeen par yani na hai zameen par
teeron pe shaahe wala karwat badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon to ragon mein kya hai khushk is khadar gala hai
khaatil bhi thak ke apne khanjar badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
khud gardane katane shabbir ko bachane
jaane ko ran mein haye kamsin machal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se jo rawan hai haye lahoo kahan hai
ye noor e kibriya ke chashme ubhal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
har shaam roz jisko royegi yaad karke
wo shaam dhal rahi hai qayyam jal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hogaya zamana shane se taaba shana
taboot chal raha hai kaandhe badal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ay naved hai ye kul karbala ka haasil
hal min ke lafz sheh ke moo se nikal rahe hai
aur teer chal rahe hai
hangame asr hai ye...
author: Ahmed Naved
